# Tender response — Framework agreement for technical property maintenance (JMK-TEK-2026/09)

Visakoivu Oy

## Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy has completed reference projects meeting both value thresholds set out in Section 3 within the qualifying period. Our equity ratio, per our most recent financial statements, is well above the 20% threshold in Section 3.4.

## Technical response

**Routine maintenance visits.** A fixed annual visit calendar is proposed for all four properties, with the standard scope of tasks confirmed at each visit through a signed visit report countersigned on site by the contracting authority's representative, giving a clear paper trail of completed work through the contract term.

**Fault response and standby.** Visakoivu operates a standby arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays, with defined response-time commitments and an on-call technician reachable by phone throughout the covered hours.

**Access control and site security.** Personnel will observe the contracting authority's access-control and site-security procedures at all four properties, including at the school and day-care premises during operating hours, with visits to those two sites scheduled outside teaching and childcare hours wherever the fault type allows it.

**Statutory electrical inspection.** Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is carried out by our own certified electrical personnel, with findings and any remedial actions recorded and reported to the contracting authority after each inspection round.

**Environmental matters.** Waste is segregated by type at each site, hazardous substances are handled and stored under our environmental management procedures, and spill-prevention measures — containment and absorbent materials on site — are applied wherever fuels or refrigerants are handled.

**Occupational safety.** A site-specific occupational safety plan covering all four properties is enclosed, setting out the hazards specific to each site and the controls applied.

**Corrective maintenance response times.** Response times are tiered by fault category, from safety-critical faults attended same day through to non-urgent repairs scheduled within the following visit window.

**Personnel qualifications.** All personnel, including subcontracted staff, hold the occupational cards and trade certificates the work requires, and are briefed on the site-specific rules for each property before starting work.

## Commercial terms

We propose the standard cost-of-living index as the price adjustment mechanism for the contract term. We accept the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level under Section 4 is not met. Invoicing is proposed monthly, covering all work carried out under the framework agreement in the preceding period.

## Forms enclosed

Curricula vitae of key personnel; completed Tender Form (Liite 1).

## Format

Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year. Prices are exclusive of value-added tax. Font size throughout is 11pt or larger.

## Annex A — Technical specification

Spare-parts availability and standard delivery times are confirmed for the installed building systems. Fire-protection systems — smoke detection, fire dampers and emergency lighting — are maintained on a defined schedule at each property. Lift maintenance is carried out under the applicable statutory periodic inspection regime.

## Annex B — Forms and commercial terms

We accept the retention terms set out in the draft contract.

Visakoivu Oy
